reviews.text:
Analysis of pros and cons of Euljiro Euljiro Entrance Station underground shopping mall
The underground shopping mall at Euljiro Entrance Station is a place visited by many people due to its variety of products and low prices, but it clearly has its pros and cons. If you are planning to shop, please refer to the information below to have a more satisfactory shopping experience.

Advantages
Variety of products: You can find a variety of products, including clothing, miscellaneous goods, and food, all in one place. In particular, it is a great place for those looking for clothes and accessories at affordable prices.
Low prices: You can enjoy shopping at lower prices than regular department stores or large shopping malls. In particular, you can purchase products at cheaper prices at wholesale stores or outlets.
Convenient accessibility: It is directly connected to Euljiro Entrance Station, so you can conveniently visit using public transportation. Additionally, there are various commercial districts nearby, making it a great place to enjoy a meal or coffee after shopping.
The fun of accidental discovery: It feels like finding hidden treasure. There are many opportunities to discover timeless classics and vintage items.
Shopping possible regardless of the weather: Located underground, you can enjoy shopping comfortably without being affected by the weather.
Cons
Narrow and complex structure: The interior of the mall is narrow and complex, so it can be difficult to get lost or find what you want.
Old facilities: Many stores are located in old buildings, so the facilities are often outdated. It is difficult to expect a pleasant shopping environment.
Inconsistent quality: Low prices can result in a mix of low-quality products. You must examine it carefully before purchasing.
Haggling may be necessary: ​​Some stores allow you to haggle, but it can be intimidating for people who are not used to haggling.
Lack of trendy products: There are more products with basic designs rather than trendy products. For those looking for trendy clothes, options can be limited. underground shopping mall

reviews.text:
Inhyeon Market is a traditional market formed in Inhyeon-dong 2-ga, Jung-gu, Seoul.
It is a market that was formed naturally from the late 1950s to the early 1960s and has a history of over 50 years.
It is also known as the place where King Inseong, the seventh son of King Seonjo, lived during the Joseon Dynasty.
Inhyeon Market, located in the back alleys of Chungmuro, famous for its movie street and printing alley, is a traditional market where the present and the past coexist.
Chungmuro ​​Printing Alley is a name that encompasses all printing alleys in three districts, including Inhyeon-dong, Eulji-ro, and Pil-dong.
Inhyeon Market is a small alley market located between the printing alleys.
Inhyeon Market, with 110 stores concentrated in an alley 2m wide and 202m long, is adjacent to tourist attractions such as Myeong-dong and Namsangol Hanok Village, so the daily floating population reaches 20,000, but it also went through a recession due to the underdeveloped environment and the aging of merchants.
Inhyeon Market was reduced to its current form in the late 1960s when Seun Shopping Center was built, but with many hidden restaurants and low prices, it became a friendly place for nearby printing workers and small merchants.
In addition, this place is famous as a place where city workers visit after work to relieve the fatigue of daily life, so it is also called a ‘taste paradise.’
Recently, young merchants and artists have opened youth stores in Inhyeon Market, allowing them to experience unique pleasures.
